firm_data.firm_description: CHAU|IP is an award-winning boutique law firm that grows and protects the value of Intellectual Property assets. They specialize in AI and other technically complex expertise.
notable_facts: Ranked #1 New York Firm and #6 US Firm in Quality by IAMS
The firm has experience working on over 250 complex AI cases in the past 2 years.
The firm's goal is to reduce the risk of ineffective, narrow, or meaningless IP by thoroughly understanding all aspects of invention and applying the law through IP experts.
technology_signals: Uses proprietary software and processes in case management and patent application preparation

ai_contact.ai_notes: The firm provides guidance on how to file and protect AI IP. They have experience working on over 250 complex AI cases in the past 2 years.
